title: 'get your bearings' at Camp Gallows returned a wall of unfamiliar sub-location names (Understory, Maud's hut, Denhollow, Long Watch, Cutter's Barrow, Rook) with relative directions between them, but none of it mapped onto the room's own compass exits (E/N/S/W/In) the way the Vale's bearings cleanly did. Read as noise rather than a usable bearing.
